summary: composer.starters shows starter chips above the composer on an empty chat; a click fills the composer (send: true sends). ChatStarters renders them in own panels; while they show, suggestions.staticChips are hidden.
howTo: Set composer: { starters: ['Was ist neu?', { label, prompt, description, icon, send }] } on AiChatProvider. A click puts prompt (default label) into the composer and focuses it; send: true sends at once. Chips are disabled while the composer is locked and disappear with the first message. String icons render through composer.renderIcon(name, { type: 'starter' }). If you used suggestions.staticChips as starters, move them to composer.starters: the static chips are hidden on an empty chat while starters show. Own panels render <ChatStarters /> above the composer. Group name: locale.startersLabel. See references/composer-starters-drafts.md#starters.
